scientific_question: How does DINOv2 compare with supervised CNN baselines?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer A questions whether a standard supervised ResNet-50 baseline on ImageNet would match or exceed DINOv2 on SEM retrieval.
existing_evidence: Compared against pHash and dHash; zero-shot DINOv2 achieves R@1=0.9819.
missing_evidence: No direct comparison with supervised CNN features (ResNet-50) on HCCI retrieval benchmark.
proposed_experiment: P13-EXP-01: Benchmark ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 on held-out Zeiss test set under identical protocol.

scientific_question: Does acquisition-aware adaptation improve generalization beyond current HCCI setting?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer B challenges whether the contrastive adapter overfits to cast iron alloy microstructures.
existing_evidence: SupCon adapter reduces gap by 68.15% on HCCI and improves Zeiss P@5 by +0.0345 (p=0.0028).
missing_evidence: Empirical evaluation on non-ferrous multi-alloy or cross-material datasets.
proposed_experiment: P13-EXP-02: Zero-shot evaluation of adapted representations on external multi-alloy/material archives.

scientific_question: Does multimodal fusion actually help if simple late fusion does not?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer A argues late linear score fusion was too simplistic to capture non-linear visual-metadata synergies.
existing_evidence: Phase 5 negative result proves late linear fusion has Delta R@1=0.0000 (alpha*=1.0).
missing_evidence: Empirical evaluation of learned non-linear fusion (gated MLP / cross-attention).
proposed_experiment: P13-EXP-03: Train and evaluate a non-linear gated MLP multimodal fusion head on HCCI.

scientific_question: Does the representation transfer to genuinely different microscopy domains?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer B asks if foundation representations work on semiconductor defects without retraining.
existing_evidence: Centroid cosine distance = 0.5842; zero-shot Micro-Recall@1 = 0.9952 on Carinthia.
missing_evidence: Comprehensive cross-domain compatibility and cross-domain retrieval matrix across multiple archives.
proposed_experiment: P13-EXP-04: Evaluate cross-domain compatibility and retrieval matrix across HCCI and Carinthia.

scientific_question: Are retrieval metrics stable under different query definitions?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer A asks if retrieval metrics are sensitive to positive-pair sampling variations.
existing_evidence: Bootstrap CIs (B=1000) and paired t-tests reported on canonical same-specimen cross-acquisition protocol.
missing_evidence: Sensitivity analysis across varying K thresholds and query stratification.
proposed_experiment: P13-EXP-05: Query perturbation and ranking stability evaluation across metric thresholds.

scientific_question: How sensitive are results to resolution preprocessing and scale-bar artifacts?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer B notes that micrographs often contain burned-in scale bars and varying resolutions.
existing_evidence: Deterministic 224x224 bicubic resizing with antialiasing applied uniformly.
dependency: P13-EXP-06: Controlled image perturbation and robustness benchmark across 5 noise/artifact conditions.

scientific_question: How useful are algorithmic curation recommendations to human researchers?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer C notes that human-in-the-loop efficiency is currently supported by computational simulation.
existing_evidence: Review queue surfaces 100% of candidate risks in top-25 budget; 769 KEEP and 5 REVIEW identified.
missing_evidence: Empirical inter-rater agreement and curator validation study with human consensus metrics.
proposed_experiment: P13-EXP-07: Design and execute formal human-curation validation protocol with inter-rater statistics.

scientific_question: How does the platform behave at larger corpus sizes?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer C notes FAISS benchmark was evaluated on N=5365 embeddings.
existing_evidence: Flat search takes 0.7348 ms; HNSW takes 0.3691 ms (1.99x speedup
proposed_experiment: Empirical scalability curves at N=10K 25K 50K 100K vectors on host hardware.
priority: P13-EXP-08: Engineering stress test evaluating indexing time memory and latency up to N=100K.

reviewer_concern: Reviewers request qualitative and diagnostic failure analysis of false nearest neighbors.
existing_evidence: Aggregate metrics reported; 5 duplicate review pairs identified in Phase 6.
missing_evidence: Granular case-by-case taxonomy of false nearest neighbors and missed positives.
proposed_experiment: P13-EXP-09: Diagnostic failure taxonomy cataloging optical confusion cases and detector boundaries.

scientific_question: Can the platform support reproducible scientific workflows under operational conditions?
reviewer_concern: Reviewer C flags that Docker runtime execution was designated as unexecuted during Phase 11/12 audit.
existing_evidence: 218/218 automated unit and platform tests passed under host Python 3.11 with L_inf<1e-6 parity.
cost: P13-EXP-10: Systematic platform hardening and security vulnerability audit across 15 failure dimensions.
